_about: 2026-11-13 (rig session, operator approved): bimanual_align9_all + the four final-push keys of bimanual_align8_depth_b (force_n 14, centre_max_mm 4.5, centre_v_mm_s 2, max_lat_mm 4.5). Reason: all9_full_1 seated but rested 6.75 mm (band ~2 mm) with 10 N; depth_b_1 stopped at the hand-over on the wrist-net bias (no D in depth_b). Every part is operator approved (A no-jump, B fast align, C2, D). Combined candidate, 2026-11-13: bimanual_align5_k4_push15_seat6_fastmove + fast step alignment (bimanual_align8_fastalign) + force-mode final push 10 N (bimanual_align8_depth_a) + approach no-jump and 2 pick attempts (bimanual_align8_nojump_retry2) + wrist-net bias (bimanual_align8_netbias). Run it only after each part passed alone on the rig (docs/real/NEXT_RIG_20261114.md).

chain_args._about: eval_chain.py arguments for the real chain (the rest are its defaults). believed_frame: plan and command on encoder FK (the only frame the real robot has).
chain_args._stop: Real run 2026-11-03: the servo integrated its target while joints 2 and 3 stuck, 6 iterations at the stop, then a 7 mm slip at a 4 mm gap. Now 2 iterations at 18 mm; the align stage closes from there with the creep law.

pick._about: Servo-descent pick (blind_insertion/pipeline/pick_servo.py): the 2040/2048 gate settings of scripts/policy/pick_expert_eval.py

batches._about: Real test batches, one change at a time (docs/real/PICK_GRASP_V3.md). One attempt per try: no retry, so each try is one count. A, B, C still press in the plan's descent: the pick2 clearances on the commanded pose. D: no press, the default clearances.

A._retry2: 2026-11-13: max_attempts 1 -> 2 for the empty close of demo_3 (one retry, press_from_attempt stays null).

insert._about: Part 4 K-J (obs_dim 68): accumulate, target cap from the policy meta (0.05), 10 s, 50 Hz; left joint-6 mask inside the loader. Seated detector: plug advance along the port axis (encoder FK) past the servo's stop gap.
insert._wrong_port: log only: in the dry runs (+/-1.5 deg offset DR) the FK lateral of good approaches reached 15 mm, a neighbouring-port lock 11 mm; set a limit only with calibrated offsets

seat2._about: 0.3 s at depth and no axial motion. No lateral stillness: after a true seat K-J keeps moving the hand (dry run: up -5 to -8 mm with the plug at full depth), and the guard then lifted seated plugs. Real ai4 seats at 3.84 s, A and A2 do not.
seat2._speed_20261110: operator approved 2026-11-10: 3 -> 6 mm/s. k4_2 was in at 8.4-9.0 mm for 3.8 s but K4 kept moving (|v| p90 5.8 mm/s): longest still run 14 of 15 ticks, no seat, guard backed out 20 mm and pulled the reader out. Replay on 10 real insertions: 6 mm/s detects all 6 seats (0.1-0.9 s sooner) and k4_2; no seat on the 3 stalls (max depth 3.2-3.6 mm).

insert._policy_file: K3 (K2 env + vision_prior_obs; rel_pose_obs). Copy from mason: docs/real/NEXT_RIG_20261109.md. Needs align.mode full (the vision prior is the align hand-over measurement).

final_push._about: Force-mode final push (deploy/bimanual/insert.py final_push_force): PD axial force ramps to force_n, the hand stays on its line (lateral and rotation springs), no fixed 15 mm target. force_n 10 N: the PD estimate of the five 15 mm position pushes of 2026-11-10/11 peaked at 9.0-13.3 N along the port axis (with 2-3 N down). Here the load is along the axis only, so joint 1 carries more torque than in those pushes (see _tau_max). Gates and stops as bimanual_align5_k4_push15_seat6_fastmove (depth >= 5, |lateral| <= 2.5; advance 4 mm, left 2 mm, grip 0.02) plus off-line 4 mm. No centring.
final_push._tau_max: Joint torque cap of the push load (N m), under safety.tau_cont_nm [9, 9, 9, 3, 3, 3]. A 10 N axial load at the 2026-11-11 seat pose needs joint 1 3.8 N m and joint 5 0.9 N m; the 15 mm position pushes used joint 1 about 2.2 N m, joint 4 about 1.0 N m.
final_push._full_depth: Report only (event insert_depth): depth at rest in seat-2 units (FK advance since the hand-over minus the vision gap). Operator "fully in" 2026-11-10/11: 7.32, 7.36, 7.56 mm (n = 3); "seated" 6.65-6.69; short or hanging 5.58-6.94. docs/real/FULL_DEPTH_20261113.md.

gripper._about: i2rt gripper 0 closed .. 1 open (position PD). Finger opening per finger (m, the sim finger joint) is linear in the reading: right through (1.0, 0.048) and (g_reader, m_reader) (deploy/config/task_h.json, 2026-10-28); left uncalibrated (proportional). close = squeeze target (force NOT calibrated: sim squeeze 12 N).
gripper._pick2: 2026-11-01 real: the 55 deg side grasp holds the reader at i2rt 0.311-0.333 (ai1-ai5 transport, mean 0.32), not 0.254 (10-28, top-down grasp); the sim holds it at 19 mm. g_reader 0.254 -> 0.32: the pick descent opening (right_approach_open_m 24 mm) then reads ~0.44 instead of 0.38 (pick1 landed on the reader with 0.38). pick2 run: grasped, but a finger brushed the reader and turned it; right_approach_open_m 0.024 -> 0.026 (reading ~0.48; the wrist nets saw 24 mm fingers in training). pick3/pick4 with 26 mm: the jaws closed empty (0.055 / 0.032), pads rode over the reader's top edges; pick2 with 24 mm closed on the reader (0.305, recovery close at the grasp pose). right_approach_open_m back to 0.024 (reading 0.437). pick6 (24 mm + press relief) grasped; operator: slightly wider would grasp better -> 0.025 (pick7). pick7 (25 mm + relief) failed -> back to 0.024.

safety._about: FlexChecker clearances (model frame, above the tabletop) on every target and measured pose; table_z = tabletop in each arm's base frame (bimanual scene: -0.033). Guards: PD torque estimate kp (target - q) + feed-forward per joint; DM4340 (joints 1-3) rated ~9 N m, DM4310 (4-6) ~3 N m.
safety._pick2: 2026-11-01 pick1: SafetyStop at the last descent tick, gripper body 15.0 mm above the table (limit 15 mm); the sim pick bottoms at 17-18 mm. body_clearance.gripper 0.015 -> 0.010 (operator decision). pick2 run: SafetyStop link_5 40.2 mm (limit 40). Sim pick minima: link_5 44-45, link_6 27, gripper 17-18 mm; real pick1/2: link_5 42.3/40.2, link_6 26.1/23.9, gripper 15.1/15.5. link_5 0.040 -> 0.030, link_6 0.020 -> 0.015 (operator approved). pick3 run: SafetyStop gripper 9 mm (limit 10) at the grasp depth: the pick COMMANDS the tips ~13 mm into the table (tip floor), measured tips +0.7 mm, measured gripper body 27 mm; commanded gripper body 9-11 mm after a 4 deg wrist correction. body_clearance.gripper 0.010 -> 0.003 (commanded pose; operator approved).
safety._pick3: No press: the command stays near the measured pose. body_clearance restored gripper 3 -> 10, link_5 30 -> 35 mm; link_6 stays 15.
safety._move_max_vel: 2026-11-11: 0.4 approved by the operator (first run fastmove_1).

align._about: deploy/bimanual/align.py; values and evidence in docs/real/ALIGN_STAGE.md
align._sim_source: port_vision held-out residuals (docs/real/PORT_VISION.md): frame noise under 0.12 mm, residual over poses across 0.18-0.38, up 0.74, gap 0.49; constant of a run: judgement, y about 0.6 mm

secondary._bias: 2026-11-13, docs/real/ROBUSTNESS_PLAN_20261113.md part B: the wrist net's up reads about +2.6 mm above port vision (n = 25 hand-overs 2026-11-03..11; seated check: vision +0.33 mm, net +2.91 mm, n = 13). The offset is subtracted from the net reading before the disagreement check; the gate widths are unchanged. NEEDS OPERATOR APPROVAL: the accepted raw up difference moves from +/-3.5 mm to -0.9..+6.1 mm.

align._disagree_mm: GUESS, never run in a loop: net against vision near the port, SD 0.25, 0.71-0.88, 0.46 mm (n = 26), constant across 1.4-1.8, up 1.5-2.0 at A2 (docs/real/WRIST_NETS_REAL.md). Limit = constant + about 2 SD. Checked at the hand-over only. Port vision alone gives the numbers the stage acts on.
align._min_clear: measured gap under 3 mm: back out 1 mm per cycle; stop under 1 mm

angle._about: rx pitch and ry yaw of the plug against the panel: port_vision panel pose + camera mount + mean real grasp. rz (roll) is not corrected: its slope on real frames is 0.39.

align._fast: docs/real/ALIGN_FAST_20261113.md. All new keys are off by default in deploy/bimanual/align.py; the values here are the fast settings.
align._frames: real: 0.85-0.97 s per measurement = rest wait >= 0.3 s + 5 frames x 87 ms (60 ms of it waiting for two new camera frames; port_vision 26 ms) + the second source every cycle.
align._slope_prior: real slopes at the hand-over, n = 15 step runs 2026-11-10/11: across 0.94-1.10, up 0.76-0.98, gap 1.02-1.12 (gate 0.6-1.6). No probe cycles. Gap and up must be known (se <= 0.2; the gap moves about 10 mm on the way in; up has the largest vision residual): if not, one extra probe on that axis (extra_probes 2). Across fails only when 2 se out of range. Offline logic test: an up slope of 0.3 stops at the scale gate (3 of 3 starts).
align._reach: real 2026-11-10/11: 123 of 229 steps ran to the 3 s timeout (reach test 0.3 mm, median moved/asked 1.09 there). Loose test per axis: each asked axis within 0.3 + 0.5 x asked, the other axes within 0.6 mm, for 3 ticks; or >= 0.6 of each asked axis done and stalled 0.5 s. Replay on the logged FK: 42 of 229 time out (2.0 s), step p50 150 -> 51 ticks.
align._reach_freeze: false: dry run seed 7044 with true: after each loose step end the goal became the measured pose while joint 2 still had about 20 mrad of lead; the hand rose about 2 mm between steps, 'correction grows' stop (up 7 -> 14.7 mm by truth). Without it (as the strict stage after a timeout) the joints finish the step.

approach_nojump._about: deploy/bimanual/chain.py RealChain + _StopDeadband (off when this block is absent or enabled is false). Real 2026-11-03..11 approaches (n=37): at the stop the servo integrated 0.3-6 mm net corrections on its command while joints 2/3 stuck (Coulomb friction > feed-forward); the command-hand lag grew up to 15 mm and the joint broke free: hand jumps 3.6-5.0 mm (6 of 18 runs 2026-11-10/11). Left hand moved <= 0.15 mm in every jump window (not the press).
approach_nojump._deadband: Per port axis (across, up, gap). Gap band 1 mm: the align stage may advance at most 16 mm (align.max_advance_mm) from the stop to the 6 mm hand-over; a 3 mm gap band let dry run seed 7041 enter at a 21 mm gap and fail that gate.
